task.source: CMS Medicare Part D Public Use Files

target.name: first_observed_published_provider_drug_relationship
target.definition: A provider-drug relationship is positive in year t when it is absent from every retained earlier CMS Part D public-use snapshot and observable in the published file for year t.

task.provider_cohort: For each target year, select up to 2,000 providers first observed strictly before that target year, choosing the smallest (SHA-256 NPI, NPI) values.
task.candidate_construction: For each eligible target provider, rank every drug observed globally in the target cohort's strictly prior history except drugs in that provider's entire strictly prior history; no sampled evaluation negatives.
task.suppression_limitation: CMS suppresses provider-drug combinations with 10 or fewer Part D claims; absence is non-observation subject to suppression and left censoring.
